posts.text: I'm excited to announce that last weekend at Queen's UX Club’s Design-a-thon, my team and I placed first! We were given the theme “moments”, and tasked with finding a way to either capture, enhance, or transform instances in one’s life into a moment. After interviewing 13 users, we found that meaningful moments were not only big life milestones, but any event with strong emotions tied to them.
